newsitem.title: GREECE: Citibank launches Greek share index fund.
newsitem.headline: Citibank launches Greek share index fund.

text.p: Citibank will introduce a new stock index mutual fund aiming to capitalise on the Greek bourse's performance in 1997 with a guarantee feature on investors' capital if stocks head south next year.
The fund, Citi-Athens 1, will fully track the bourse's benchmark share index from January 20 to January 19 1998, Citibank said.
The minimum investment was set at one share at a price of 2.5 million drachmas.

If the index turns out negative returns next year, shareholders of Citi-Athens 1 are guaranteed redemptions at the same net asset value per share -- they may redeem shares at an NAV of 2.5 million drachmas per share.

"The investment will seek to benefit by any positive performance of the share index during the above period with a set return cap twice the prevailing one-year interbank offer rate (Athibor) on January 24," Citibank said.
